sample_unit: men undergoing prostate biopsy (243 MSM, 243 heterosexual men)
models_evaluated: logistic regression (PSA, DRE, PSA+DRE, PI-RADS, PI-RADS+DRE)

links.outcome: Prostate cancer risk calculator AUC and calibration in MSM vs heterosexual men
links.effect: MRI-based calculators had higher AUCs in MSM, best for PLUM and UCLA; PI-RADS ≥3 sensitivity 94% in MSM vs 87% in heterosexual men; no recalibration needed.
links.quote: MRI-based calculators showed higher AUCs in MSM, with best performance for PLUM and UCLA.

screen.reason: Evaluates existing prostate cancer risk prediction calculators across sexual orientation subgroups (MSM vs HSM) to assess equity and whether recalibration is needed.
